purpose: Teach: やれる/切符/通す/光る/盛り上がる/不公平/仕上がり/固い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、一人で、絶対、やれる、絶対、わよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm telling you — I can absolutely, totally run this shop by myself.
lines.style: Bright and certain. Chin up slightly. Each 'absolutely' lands with gentle conviction, not force. Open posture, like she's already picturing it working.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、バスの、絶対、切符、絶対、買えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really did it — I bought my own bus ticket!
lines.style: Small triumph in the voice. Not loud, but clear. Slight lift at the end, reaching toward her approval. The pride of doing something alone for the first time.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ママに、絶対、お電話、絶対、通す、絶対、ね
lines.en: And Sho, I'll definitely call your mom to let her know, okay?
lines.style: Warm and practical. Matter-of-fact delivery, the way you confirm logistics with someone you trust. Not rushed — measured and reassuring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お庭で、本気で、絶対、ホタル、絶対、光る、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis… the fireflies in the yard really do glow, don't they?
lines.style: Soft wonder. Trailing upward slightly, like he's noticing something for the first time. Quieter than before — the voice of a child watching something magical and wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、本気で、絶対、盛り上がる、絶対、と、絶対、嬉しいわ
lines.en: That makes me so happy, Sho — knowing your shop will be full of people and doing well.
lines.style: Genuine warmth. Slow, unhurried. Tender on 'happy.' The voice of someone who means what she says and doesn't need to convince anyone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、お兄ちゃんだけ、絶対、お小遣い、絶対、多い、絶対、不公平、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis, it's not fair — my brother gets more allowance than me!
lines.style: Half-whine, half-serious complaint. A child pushing at the edges of an unfair rule. Slight pitch rise on the complaint, but underneath is real confusion about why.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、新ケーキの、絶対、仕上がり、絶対、見てみる?本気で
lines.en: Want to come see how my new cake turned out?
lines.style: Inviting and a little eager. Warm opening, like she's extending something she's proud of and hoping he'll say yes. Not pushy — genuinely curious what he'll think.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、心、絶対、固い、絶対、よ
lines.en: My heart is really strong and decided, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Quiet, steady conviction. The voice of a small boy who has made up his mind about something important. No hesitation, no seeking approval — just stating fact.
